title: Movers Direct
summary: A UK removals website rebuilt with a bespoke WordPress theme and custom quoting plugin, replacing a slow third-party solution.
technology: WordPress · PHP · Custom Theme · Custom Plugin
challenge: The existing third-party quoting tool was bloated and was contributing to poor page-speed performance.
solution: Built a custom WordPress theme from scratch.
Developed a bespoke quoting plugin around origin, destination, property size and preferred date.
Replaced the third-party quoting dependency with project-specific PHP logic.
Optimised the quoting flow with performance and Core Web Vitals in mind.
outcomes: Substantial improvement in page-speed scores after replacing the third-party tool.
Fully bespoke theme and plugin with no off-the-shelf quoting solution.
